svg.aria-label: A key: in this drawing a gray circle is one atom of aluminum; a large open circle and a small dark circle are other kinds of atom; two large open circles touching are atoms joined together; two large open circles apart are atoms not joined; a line says the words under each drawing say which kind of atom its circles are
svg.text: one atom of aluminum, in this drawing: a gray circle
other kinds of atom: a different size and shade each
atoms joined together are drawn touching
atoms not joined are drawn apart
The words under each drawing say which kind of atom its circles are.
